latHint: Think a deep longing - not an evergreen.
pivHint: A PINE is an evergreen tree - but to PINE for someone far away means to do what?
winText: Aching heart. PINE was the pivot - evergreen tree to a heart that will YEARN.
lossText: YEARN - to long for deeply. PINE was the pivot: evergreen PINE to PINE for someone.
